InstallPage.title: Badminton Meetup
InstallPage.tagline: Find a group, sign up, queue, play — one tap each
InstallPage.installedBody: You opened this from the home-screen icon. Go find a group.

android.title: Add to your home screen
android.body: No app store. One tap installs it: an icon, full screen, notifications — just like a regular app.
android.fallbackBody: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right corner → "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".

ios.title: Install on iPhone / iPad
ios.body: iPhone has no install button — add it from Safari by hand. Takes 30 seconds:
ios.step2: Tap the Share button at the bottom
ios.step3: Scroll down, tap "Add to Home Screen" → "Add"
ios.notSafari: You're not in Safari. Copy the link and open it in Safari first:

line.title: Leave LINE first
line.body: LINE's built-in browser can't install apps. Tap below and this page reopens in your phone's browser.

inapp.title: Open in a real browser first
inapp.body: You're inside the FB / IG / Threads in-app browser, which can't install. Tap "⋯" → "Open in browser", or copy the link into Chrome / Safari.

desktop.title: Scan with your phone
desktop.body: This is a mobile app. Point your phone camera at the QR code to open the install page.
desktop.orOpen: Or send the link to your phone:

InstallPage.useInBrowser: Don't want to install? Just open it in the browser →
InstallPage.whyTitle: Why add it to the home screen?
InstallPage.why1: One icon on your home screen — no digging through chats for the link
InstallPage.why2: "You're up" push notifications so you never miss a court
InstallPage.why3: Full screen and fast, same as a store-installed app
InstallPage.hostBody: The host console is a separate app: open groups, assign courts and collect fees on one screen.
